description: This command assigns group names to objects based on their relation to geometric sets. Use of the group logic is described in Groups . All polygons in all sets are assigned a surface number – polygons that are connected topologically will be assigned the same number. From the position of each object, a ray is projected in the direction specified by the projection keyword. FLAC3D will count the number of times that ray intersects each surface, and use that information to assign a group name.
notes: '[assignoptions]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (the keywords on this page whose syntax carries no marker).

syntax.6.0: data {scalar keyword | tensor keyword | vector keyword}

description.6.0: This assigns group names to the set of user-define data based on their location. Options: scalar keyword: Assign groups to the user-defined scalar data using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; tensor keyword: Assign groups to the user-defined tensors data using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).; vector keyword: Assign groups to the user-defined vectors data using one or more of the common option keywords (see below).

keywords.name: block
keywords.description: Assign groups to blocks from their position relative to the geometry. A block with no intersection gets the group 'No Intersections'.

keywords.name: zone
keywords.description: Assign groups to zones (or grid points if the option grid-point keyword is given) using a \(Type Block\) keyword.

keywords.name: kwd:projection
keywords.description: Specifies the direction the projection is made from each location considered. By default this direction is (0,0,1) .

keywords.name: kwd:set
keywords.description: Specifies the name of the set to use. More than one set name may be specified. By default, the current geometry set is used.

keywords.name: kwd:slot
keywords.description: Specifies the slot that the group names will be assigned in. If not specified the slot name is ‘Default’.
